card.description: Days logged by students using the StepStreak fitness app. Each day is labeled Active Day or Rest Day. Data comes from each phone's step counter, which tracks steps, walking minutes, and floors climbed. Students also wrote down what they did that day.

context.potentialUses: Predict whether a day was an Active Day or a Rest Day, to keep a student's activity streak going.

fields.description: An ID for each row of data.
What the student said they did that day.
Minutes the phone counted as walking.
Floors the phone counted as climbed.
Whether the day was an Active Day or a Rest Day.
